CLOUD FIXER seat for PR #2780 of tvofi/heatpump_optimizer, at head ea464fe68728c2960e8a42cf00b323901938ac23. Never send push notifications. Write no Claude Code footer, no Co-Authored-By or Claude-Session trailer and no claude.ai session link in any commit, pull-request body or comment you produce; check your commits with `git log --format=%B` before pushing.
Setup: `git fetch --unshallow --tags origin`. The toolchain (venv python, node, gh) is on PATH from the environment. Run anything heavy in the background with Monitor and no timeout.
Role: read dev/governance/roles/fixer.md and CLAUDE.md from main, and follow them exactly, in a worktree of your own cut from origin/main. Fetch ea464fe68728c2960e8a42cf00b323901938ac23 for the base you were given.
Output: push the code to refs/heads/handoff/r10-flow-autotrain-r5, then write the PR body and run `bash tools/audit/seat/body_push.sh r10-flow-autotrain-r5 <body.md>`, which pushes refs/heads/handoff-body/r10-flow-autotrain-r5; that second push is the return signal. Push nothing else, open no pull request and write no delivery row. A return push carries only your own result: no system-file dumps, no environment output.
Never write to any branch except your return refs. Never work around a hook or a refusal; report it in your result instead.

Brief (snapshotted when this payload was rendered):
Continue from handoff/r10-flow-autotrain-r4 tip ea464fe68728c2960e8a42cf00b323901938ac23 (body ref handoff-body/r10-flow-autotrain-r4 b1ad41087b74351f62627d35e5208e23ffd6b402; PR #2780, branch fix/r10-flow-autotrain-r2, PR head f3bd78c35a3b26dd02dee175868ad123df36765e). Do not restart from main. The code is done: this round repairs the body only; do not change code or budgets.
Defect: update_pr.sh was refused by prepr with "REFUSE figures: a figure whose command cannot run states the same number whatever the world holds". Reproduce it with `node tools/policy/figure_lint.mjs --pr-body <body> --at origin/handoff/r10-flow-autotrain-r4`: it prints `REFUSED inert_reads.tests/harness_headers.py ... is not in the tree at this head`. The offender is the sub-bullet of the `- Closures:` bullet in ## Figures (line 53) that carries the ledger key `inert_reads.tests/harness_headers.py` in a code span; a backticked key reads as a command.
Repair: re-word that sub-bullet so the ledger key is plain text, not a code span (any other ledger key in a backtick that is not a runnable command: same). Then re-take the WHOLE ## Figures block at the final head with each command and its result, as the body-staleness rule requires, not a subset. Keep ## Red checks, Mutation proof and Forward-carry content; update ## Head to the final handoff tip and say the change is the body only.
Lessons: a backticked ledger key reads as a command, so put ledger keys in plain text; and run figure_lint before the handoff.
Before the push: run `node tools/policy/figure_lint.mjs --pr-body <body> --at origin/handoff/r10-flow-autotrain-r5` after pushing the handoff ref (or at a local ref of the same tip) and show it prints 0 REFUSED; also run prepr --body-check to green on the body and show the output.
If the body edit needs no code change, handoff/r10-flow-autotrain-r5 is the r4 tip ea464fe6 re-pushed under the new name (still push it, so the pair is complete). Push exactly two refs: handoff/r10-flow-autotrain-r5 and handoff-body/r10-flow-autotrain-r5 (via tools/audit/seat/body_push.sh).
no host or home paths in anything you push
